title: get_action_choices returns undeclared 'action_taken' key on GAME_TARGET auto-cancel
description:
When get_action_choices handles a GAME_TARGET with no valid optional targets, it auto-cancels and puts `action_taken: auto_cancelled_no_targets` in the result. But GetActionChoicesTool.java does not declare `action_taken` in its @Tool.Field annotations, triggering the undeclared output key validation error.

Observed in game_20260302_005956_g4 at 01:16:45 for Grok4F Valley: 'Tool get_action_choices returned undeclared output key action_taken.'

Source: BridgeCallbackHandler.java:1223 — `result.put("action_taken", "auto_cancelled_no_targets")` in the GAME_TARGET case of getActionChoices().

The sister tool ChooseActionTool.java correctly declares this field (line 18). GetActionChoicesTool.java needs the same @Tool.Field annotation.

Fix: Add `@Tool.Field(name = "action_taken", type = "string", description = "What was done when an action was auto-resolved")` to GetActionChoicesTool.java.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260302_005956_g4/Grok4F Valley_mcp.log: undeclared output key error
- Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:1223
- Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/tools/GetActionChoicesTool.java: missing annotation
